description: The overall average option volume ratio is the average of the transaction-reference and trader-type combination averages.

b.request: Inner join sentiment snapshots to transaction records and their traders; for each (`transref`, `tradekind`) pair, average `optvolrt`, then calculate its absolute deviation from the overall average of those pair averages; within each non-null trader type, retain pairs whose deviation exceeds that type’s average deviation, and report the averages of their option volume ratios, deviations, and excess deviations, ignoring nulls and without rounding; return no rows if the overall average is null
b.sql: WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s INNER JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = s.transref INNER JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), deviations AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, avg_optvolrt, ABS(avg_optvolrt - (SELECT AVG(avg_optvolrt) FROM pair_averages)) AS deviation FROM pair_averages), type_deviations AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, avg_optvolrt, deviation, AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_deviation FROM deviations WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(deviation - type_avg_deviation) AS avg_excess_deviation FROM type_deviations WHERE deviation > type_avg_deviation GROUP BY tradekind

a.request: Link each sentiment snapshot to its transaction record (`transref` = `transreg`) and to that record's trader (`trdref` = `tradereg`), dropping snapshots without both matches. For each combination of transaction reference (`transref`) and trader type (`tradekind`), compute the average option volume ratio (`optvolrt`). Take as the baseline the plain average of these per-combination averages, with each combination counting equally. Each combination's deviation is its average minus the baseline (no rows if the baseline is missing). Within each trader type, average those deviations. Keep only the combinations whose deviation is above their trader type's average deviation, and give each one an excess: its deviation minus the type's average deviation. Combinations with no trader type get a deviation too but are dropped at this comparison. Finally, for each trader type, report the type, the average of the kept combinations' average option volume ratios, the average of their deviations, and the average of their excess. Averages ignore missing values. No rounding.
a.sql: WITH combinations AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), deviations AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, avg_optvolrt, avg_optvolrt - AVG(avg_optvolrt) OVER () AS deviation FROM combinations), compared AS (SELECT tradekind, avg_optvolrt, deviation, AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_deviation FROM deviations) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(deviation - type_avg_deviation) AS avg_excess FROM compared WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL AND deviation > type_avg_deviation GROUP BY tradekind

c.request: Link each sentiment snapshot to its transaction record (`transref` = `transreg`) and that record's trader (`trdref` = `tradereg`), keeping only full matches, and compute the average option volume ratio (`optvolrt`) for each transaction reference and trader type (`tradekind`) pair. Measure each pair's deviation from the overall average option volume ratio (no rows if that's missing). Then, within each trader type, keep only the pairs whose deviation beats the type's average deviation, and note by how much (pairs with no trader type drop out at this step). For each trader type, what are the average option volume ratio, the average deviation and the average excess of those pairs? Averages ignore missing values. Don't round. The overall average option volume ratio is the average of the transaction-reference and trader-type combination averages.
c.sql: WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), deviations AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, avg_optvolrt, ABS(avg_optvolrt - (SELECT AVG(avg_optvolrt) FROM pair_averages)) AS deviation FROM pair_averages), type_deviations AS (SELECT tradekind, avg_optvolrt, deviation, AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_deviation FROM deviations WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(deviation - type_avg_deviation) AS avg_excess FROM type_deviations WHERE deviation > type_avg_deviation GROUP BY tradekind

d.request: Link each sentiment snapshot to its transaction record (`transref` = `transreg`) and that record’s trader (`trdref` = `tradereg`), keeping only full matches. Compute the average option volume ratio (`optvolrt`) for each transaction-reference and trader-type (`tradekind`) pair. Calculate the overall average as the average of those pair averages, ignoring missing values; return no rows if it is missing. For each pair, calculate its deviation from the overall average. Within each trader type, keep only pairs whose deviation exceeds that type’s average deviation, and calculate the excess; exclude pairs with no trader type. For each trader type, what are the average option volume ratio, average deviation, and average excess of the retained pairs? Ignore missing values in averages and do not round.
d.sql: WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s INNER JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS overall_avg FROM pair_averages), deviations AS (SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.avg_optvolrt, p.avg_optvolrt - o.overall_avg AS deviation FROM pair_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), type_averages AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS avg_type_deviation FROM deviations GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT d.tradekind, AVG(d.avg_optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(d.deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(d.deviation - ta.avg_type_deviation) AS avg_excess FROM deviations AS d INNER JOIN type_averages AS ta ON d.tradekind = ta.tradekind WHERE d.deviation > ta.avg_type_deviation GROUP BY d.tradekind
